VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 58 tests pass and describes the fix in detail, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 58 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof rather than assertion. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
